comparison.objective: Wring a diagnostic swab in an extraction tube and discard it.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain compliant wall pressure on the swab head while repeatedly rotating and withdrawing the swab.
comparison.success_condition: Five net turns at the bottom, continuously squeezed rotating withdrawal, swab in bin, and hands clear. No rigid locking or dynamic test criterion.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated compliant squeezing around a moving sample tool, not rigid fine-tool engagement and shock-absorber commissioning.
